title: MOONSHOT : A Framework for Multi-Objective Pruning of Vision and Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.13287v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Weight pruning is a common technique for compressing large neural networks. We focus on the challenging post-training one-shot setting, where a pre-trained model is compressed without any retraining. Existing one-shot pruning methods typically optimize a single objective, such as a layer-wise reconstruction loss or a second-order Taylor approximation of the training loss. We highlight that neither objective alone is consistently the most effective across architectures and sparsity levels. Motivated by this insight, we propose MOONSHOT, a general and flexible framework that extends any single-objective pruning method into a multi-objective formulation by jointly optimizing both the layer-wise reconstruction error and second-order Taylor approximation of the training loss. MOONSHOT acts as a wrapper around existing pruning algorithms. To enable this integration while maintaining scalability to billion-parameter models, we propose model

translated_title: MOONSHOT：一个面向视觉模型与大语言模型的多目标剪枝框架
translated_abstract: 权重剪枝是压缩大型神经网络的常用技术。我们聚焦于具有挑战性的训练后一次性剪枝设置，即在不进行任何再训练的情况下压缩预训练模型。现有的一次性剪枝方法通常只优化单一目标，例如逐层重构损失或训练损失的二阶泰勒近似。我们强调，没有任何单一目标能够在所有架构和稀疏度水平上都始终保持最优效果。基于这一洞察，我们提出了MOONSHOT，一个通用且灵活的框架，它通过联合优化逐层重构误差和训练损失的二阶泰勒近似，将任何单目标剪枝方法扩展为多目标形式。MOONSHOT作为现有剪枝算法的包装器运行。为了在实现这种集成的同时保持对十亿参数级模型的可扩展性，我们提出了模型……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MOONSHOT提出了一个通用灵活的框架，通过联合优化逐层重构误差和训练损失的二阶泰勒近似两个目标，将任何单目标剪枝方法扩展为多目标形式，并能扩展应用于十亿参数级的大模型。
en_tdlr: MOONSHOT is a general and flexible framework that extends any single-objective pruning method into a multi-objective formulation by jointly optimizing layer-wise reconstruction error and second-order Taylor approximation of the training loss, while remaining scalable to billion-parameter models.
